mstts:express-as.prosody: You ever notice how everyday life can feel like a nonstop parade of little annoyances, worries, and things just fighting for your attention? Sometimes, it's like your inner calm is hanging by a thread, right? Well, imagine what it would feel like to step back from all that noise—to breathe a little deeper, let go of the small stuff, and find a sense of peace that doesn’t get shaken by every little bump in the road. That’s exactly the path Richard Carlson offers us in his uplifting book, Don't Sweat the Small Stuff ... and It's All Small Stuff. Together, we're invited to gently rethink what really matters—to discover the quiet strength that comes from letting go of the trivial and holding onto what brings meaning and joy. As we move forward, you’ll find simple, practical ways to shift from feeling overwhelmed to feeling steady and calm, even when life gets messy. We’ll explore how a small change in attitude—like choosing patience, or showing a little more kindness to yourself—can make even the busiest days feel lighter and more manageable. So, if you’re ready to let the little things lose their power and welcome more balance into your life, you’re in the right place. Let’s take this journey together and see how a few gentle shifts can open the door to a calmer, more grateful way of living.
